overview: Global Trek — world-class Himalayan adventure travel and trekking platform with 15 trek routes, yatra pilgrimage packages, and a full booking system.
features: Foxico-style desktop homepage with 5 floating trek/yatra cards and dot navigation
Airbnb-style mobile homepage with search, filter pills, and bottom nav
Floating parallax hero on trek and yatra detail pages
Illustrated SVG trail maps with interactive waypoints
Review, gallery, and gear sections on all detail pages
IndiHikes-style booking flow with add-on boxes and Razorpay payment
